summary: The diff pasted into this review prompt was itself truncated mid-file (the same 60000-byte supervisor-pipeline defect this PR's own PROGRESS.md documents happening to a prior audit), so I pulled the full diff directly from the repo via `git diff origin/main...HEAD` and reviewed all 27 changed files, ran `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean) and the 5 phase_8 test files together (41/41 pass, confirming no cross-file mock leak). The implementation genuinely closes the 5 scoped gap items (prompt translation/localization/marketplace/export/import) by extending the existing Prompt Operating System rather than duplicating it: real LLM calls via the established resolvePlatformModelConfig()+callLLMJson() pattern, content cached per (version, locale) to avoid re-translation, all writes gated behind requirePromptPermissionForUser() at veridian_admin (matching the existing bar for every other prompt-OS write), all DB access via Drizzle's parameterized query builder (no raw SQL injection surface), import validates bundle shape and never trusts the bundle's own semver/lifecycle claims (new versions always land as Draft, re-earning Production status through the real state machine), and the export/import test suite exercises a real round trip against a mocked DB with a legitimate content-based idempotency check. The RLS migration (drizzle/0269) correctly reasons that app_runtime is NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS and uses FOR ALL USING(true)/WITH CHECK(true) policies matching the GRANTs, consistent with the platform-wide (non-tenant) posture of the existing prompt_templates/prompt_versions tables. No .github/workflows/** files are touched. Migration numbering (0269/0270) is sequential with no collision against current main.
issues: The diff supplied in this review's prompt was materially incomplete (truncated mid-file at src/app/api/prompt-os/localize/route.ts) -- I verified the review myself against the full diff pulled directly from the repo rather than trusting the pasted excerpt; the underlying supervisor-pipeline truncation issue this PR's own history describes (head -c 60000 in supervisor-entrypoint.sh) still needs the separate claude-control-repo fix flagged in this task's PROGRESS.md.

drizzle/0269 and drizzle/0270 are hand-authored but NOT applied to the live database (deliberately left for the supervising/merging session, same convention as prior migrations) -- whoever performs the tier2 human sign-off/merge must apply both migrations live or the new API routes will fail against a real DB.

Minor: translatePromptVersion/localizePromptVersion do a check-then-insert against a unique (prompt_version_id, locale) / (prompt_translation_id) index without a transaction or upsert -- two concurrent requests for the same version+locale could race and surface a raw unhandled DB unique-constraint error instead of a clean ServiceError. Low likelihood (admin-only, low-traffic action) and not a security issue, but worth a follow-up.
